market_holds: Sealed baseline (2026-11-11 18:09 UTC): spot 12.33, event-implied move 10.65% (13.1% front straddle, expiry 11-13), ATM IV 179.5%, skew -10.25 vol points with calls paid over puts, put/call OI 0.5. Run-up +24.2% over 5 days and +11.9% over 20 days after a ~30% October fall in small-cap space (247wallst 2026-10-26), still 73% below its 52-week high. Last three prints moved +4.42, +2.35, +3.60 on the day (median 4.42% over 7). Consensus Q3 revenue ~$243-248m (Zacks $243.3m; B. Riley's 2026-11-04 note quotes $246m consensus, own $252m; Fiscal.ai $247.5m), EBITDA consensus ~$4.1m, EPS about -$0.12. FY26 guide $900m-1bn reaffirmed 2026-08-13 with 'very strong visibility' to the low end only and the midpoint dependent on definitization; Street FY ~$921m, already near the low end. Short interest ~36.4m shares, ~22.6% of shares out, at the 2026-09-30 settlement (altindex/FINRA), 4.3 days to cover. Price-target cuts into the print: KeyBanc to $30, B. Riley to $34, both on sector multiple compression, both still buy-rated.
view: The stock trades on bookings and backlog conversion, not on EPS. The last two quarters both missed revenue by about 7-10% (Q1 $186.7m vs ~$206.7m, Q2 $206.2m vs ~$220.8m), and both times the stock still closed up on the day (+2.35%, +3.60%) on bookings, then sold off over the following weeks. Q3 needs about 20% sequential growth to reach the ~$247m consensus. That is plausible as Lanteris and the 18-spacecraft Golden Dome (AMDT3) work ramp, but it is exactly the kind of timing-dependent number this company has missed. A peer, Redwire, fell ~20% on 2026-11-05 on a revenue miss despite a record backlog and a 1.73 book-to-bill. On the other side: bookings should be strong (about $300m awarded quarter-to-date by mid-August, plus the Golden Dome order; B. Riley sees book-to-bill above 1.2), and the FY consensus already sits at the guide's low end, so a narrowing to $900-950m is roughly priced. The 24% bounce into the print and ~22% short interest raise the size of the move in both directions. There is a lean against a clean beat, but nothing I found is a dated datapoint the price misses, so this is about 45/55 and not a bet.

recommendation.reason: The lean down rests on two misses in a row, a 20% sequential step needed to hit consensus, a peer punished for a similar timing miss and a 24% sector-driven bounce into the print. But the market has rewarded this company's bookings over its revenue misses on the day itself in each of the last three prints. Q3 bookings look strong, and the FY consensus already sits at the low end of the guide. With no independent datapoint showing the quarter came in short, the probability does not reach 65.
recommendation.what_would_flip_it: Q3 revenue at or above ~$250m with the FY guide held at $900m-1bn, plus a large definitized Golden Dome booking (book-to-bill >1.2) would make an up-move by 13:00 likely against a 22% short base.

self_critique: Bookings are the real line, and they may be very strong: the Golden Dome order plus ~$300m QTD awards could put book-to-bill well above 1. The stock has risen on the day of every one of the last three prints despite revenue misses, and with ~22% short interest and calls bid, a held guide could squeeze it higher by 13:00. My down lean rests on a pattern (misses) and one peer's reaction, not on a dated datapoint about this quarter.
